title: What would YOU consider an acceptable level of knowledge?

posts.author: Oremuse
posts.body:
I have some programming knowledge, although very little in javascript.
How well do you believe someone needs to know and understand the basic MV functions before moving on to plugins?
I'm obviously still figuring it out and I am trying to develop a game with no combat just as a challenge for myself, so I won't be needing all those options for now.
What should I have a good grasp off in your opinion?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I don't think there's a lot of point in saying "you need X degree of knowledge" or "you will fail if you don't know these specific things." Especially if you have coding experience in other languages, going to a new one should be pretty simple since you can Google the differences in syntax that you don't know.
If you can look at the code in the core scripts or in someone else's plugin and understand what it's doing, then you should be able to write your own.
Probably the most important thing in plugins is to look at how other plugin authors alias/overwrite core functions.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Here's my checklist for RPG Maker plugin programmers:
Understand when and when not to use
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Immediately_invoked_function_expression
, and also understand what you want to put inside it and what you want above it.
Understand aliasing and overriding methods. Understand inheritance. Understand when to use which of those.
Know how you write plugins defensively so they will not battle with other plugins. E.g., a minimap renders all events. Another plugin lets spawn events during gameplay. Still, the minimap needs to render spawned events, too.
Know how you write a plugin so it interacts with other plugins, e.g., your plugin adds a new button "crafting", another plugin adds icons to every menu button but not to yours because it doesn't know about your button or which icon you want. Your task: Your button should show a crafting icon if and only if this 3rd-party plugin is included in the game.
Know about "Imported" in plugins.
